QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] A Quick Look Back
QuestInfo.0:
According to the Memory Keeper, you must return to where everything first started to regain your memories.
That would be where you met #p3000018#, or where you formed the Heliseum Force...
QuestInfo.1: Velderoth and Kyle were the only ones who treated you like a friend. The memories of their friendship make you wistful for old times...
QuestInfo.2: Velderoth has changed. Kyle was swept away by his life as Kaiser. You have become the hottest battlefield idol ever known. Things change, but the past is always there. Everything is going to be okay.
